name: MiMo V2.6 Distill Qwen 9B
short: Xiaomi's Sep 2026 MIT 9.41B dense SFT of Qwen3.5-9B, released as an agentic-RL research baseline: SWE-bench Verified 61.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 37.1%, self-host only.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
pricingNote: $0 - MIT open weights, self-hosted (18.85 GB BF16); no hosted route on Zen, OpenRouter or HF inference
pricingTiers: Self-host $0 (MIT weights, 18.85 GB BF16); no hosted route exists
standout: A purpose-built starting checkpoint for open agentic-RL research, with the base-model deltas published (SWE-Pro 32.0 -> 44.6).
tradeoff: No hosted route, no standard reasoning benchmarks, and every published score is vendor-measured on a mix of internal MiMo sets.
